items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Frayne – and Kelly. Kelly wants to play.

ctx.x: Frayne – and Kelly. Kelly wants to play. He’s in school. He went back to school. He’s getting his degree, and he loved to play, but he doesn’t have a career.
Speaking of school, I saw one reference in a biography. It said that you completed your degree at DePaul. Is that correct?
